_comment: EXAMPLE house-scan config (fictional cities). Copy to $MINERU_HOME/config/house_scan_config.json (or point MINERU_HOUSE_SCAN_CONFIG at your copy) and edit. The scanner (scripts/house_scan.py) re-reads it every run, so no launchd reload is needed. Every place, ZIP, school and address the scanner knows comes from this file.
_price_and_size_note: Hard filters, applied both on the Redfin URL and again after parsing. Missing card stats pass.
_cities_note: One Redfin search per city. slug is the Redfin path segment city/<id>/<ST>/<Name>. Redfin resolves ONLY by the numeric id (the tail is cosmetic), so look the id up via Redfin's own location search; a wrong id silently lands on a same-named city elsewhere. The ids below are placeholders. redfin_state_code adds Redfin's /<ST>/ link pattern as a fallback card selector.
_neighborhood_policy_note: THE LOCATION GATE. A listing surfaces only if classify_location() returns include. A listing whose parsed city has no entry under cities is always excluded (Redfin spills neighboring towns into each search). Per-city order, first hit wins: require_city_in_address, include_keywords, exclude_keywords, exclude_zips, include_zips, mixed_zips (-> mixed_zip_default), city default_verdict, global default_verdict. zip_regex is optional; its first capture group is the ZIP (default: the 5 digits after a two-letter state code).
_property_type_excludes_note: Second-line filter after the location gate: drop condo units and new-construction plan pages that leak past Redfin's property-type filter. Case-insensitive Python regexes; empty lists fall back to the DEFAULT_* patterns in scripts/house_scan_neighborhoods.py.
_address_blocklist_note: Personal veto list: case-insensitive substring match on the address. A full address vetoes one listing; a partial street ('Example Ln, Cedar Point') vetoes the whole street.
_deal_flags_note: Any one trigger fires a deal flag. Flags are ranking signals and fire on already-seen listings; they are not the gate for new listings (location is).
_steep_discount_note: A listing this far under its city median $/sqft is a red flag, not a top pick: it loses score and lands in the VERIFY bucket.
_median_ppsf_note: City median list $/sqft, used by the below-median flag and the ranking. Refresh quarterly.
_city_desirability_tiers_note: Higher = more desirable (fabric + school district). Baseline 0 is neutral; each step adds value_score_weights.city_tier. Cities not listed score 0.
_school_note: Per-listing GreatSchools ratings scraped from the Redfin detail page, cached once per listing. school_verdicts_path (relative to MINERU_HOME) holds researched per-school include/exclude verdicts {"verdicts": [{name, cities, verdict, reason, date, source}]}; an explicit verdict beats the numeric floors both ways. The min_*_rating floors are the fallback for unresearched schools (0 = tier not gated); min_school_rating_avg > 0 adds an average floor. Unknown school data never blocks.
_ranking_note: Score = city_tier * tier + schools * (school_avg - 5) + capped below-median bonus - steep-discount penalty + price_cut * drop + dom_bonus * min(dom, 60) + sqft_bonus * max(0, sqft - 1500). See score_listing() in scripts/house_scan_neighborhoods.py.
_digest_caps_note: Per-bucket caps. Aim for a handful of listings per week.
_paths_note: brief_dir is relative to MINERU_BRIEFS_ROOT; seen_state_path and log_path to MINERU_HOME. browser_bin / deliver_bin are optional (defaults: $MINERU_HOME/bin/browser, $MINERU_HOME/scripts/deliver-output.py).
